title: Tokyo Marathon EXPO 2027
claims: Tokyo Marathon EXPO 2027 runs on 4–5 March 10:00–21:00 and 6 March 10:00–18:00.
Packet pickup at the EXPO runs 4–5 March 10:00–20:30 and 6 March 10:00–17:30.
Packet pickup is in person only, with photo-ID check; proxy pickup is not allowed.
Runners receive a wristband at packet pickup that must be worn until the finish.

claimVerification.note: 同段写明必须本人领取，禁止代理，并检查带照片证件。
同段写明发放 wristband，须戴到终点。
